newsitem.title: USA: Cummins's Onan to close Huntsville plant.
newsitem.headline: Cummins's Onan to close Huntsville plant.

text.p: Onan Corp, a unit of Cummins Engine Co Inc, said Tuesday it would close its Huntsville, Ala. plant, which employs 600 workers.
Onan, a producer of generator sets, alternators and related equipment, said it would remain in its current business.
The Huntsville plant is expected to close by late 1997 or early 1998.
President Jack Edwards said the decision to close the plant had to do with capital investment and technology relating to small gasoline engines and excess capacity.
